# Security policy

## Supported versions

Dues has not published a stable release yet. Security fixes are applied to the
latest revision of `main`; older development snapshots are not maintained.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** action in the repository Security tab
to open a private report. Include the affected revision, impact, reproduction
steps, and any suggested mitigation. Use synthetic data only—never attach a
real Dues backup or private payment details.

If private vulnerability reporting is unavailable, open a public issue with
only a non-sensitive summary and ask the maintainer to establish a private
channel. Do not publish exploit instructions, secrets, or user data.

The maintainer should acknowledge a report within three business days, keep the
reporter informed while impact and remediation are assessed, and coordinate
disclosure after a fix is available. Good-faith research that avoids privacy
violations, service disruption, and access to other people's data is welcome.
